payload.recallText: At the beginning, a brother and sister were talking about a letter the brother got. The letter was about the brother playing baseball. The sister asked if he lost his spot, and the brother said kind of, but was going to make more money. He then said he had to wind his pitching arm up and started going through the motions. Right as he did this, his mother walked in with a watering pot, and he knocked it out of her hand. It broke and spilled water all over the floor, and his mother said she was glad it was not one of the good pots. His mom asked him about the letter then, and he said it was from the owner of the Pisstons the team he plays for. The letter said St Louis was interested in picking him up to go to the big leagues. His mom seemed excited, and he said he would get more money. They also spoke about the other letter, which he said was from one of his admirers whose name is Mabel.
